title: Image requests get a semantic cache
summary:
Image caching learned that a few extra dots do not make a new prompt.

Image requests can now match cached results for similar prompts, not just exact repeats. Removing punctuation and collapsing repeated spaces before embedding means prompts like “test.” and “test...” normalize the same way.

daily.title: Smarter image caching
daily.text: Similar image prompts can now match cached results, even when punctuation or repeated spaces differ. [Try image generation](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/{prompt}).
